entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: An artificial planar portal created by Rashmi, stolen by Tezzeret and installed in his body; it can transport only non-organic or dead matter and planeswalkers.

entities.name: Rashmi
entities.description: The inventor on Avishkar who created the Planar Bridge.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The plane where the Planar Bridge was created.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who stole the Planar Bridge for Bolas, built it into his body, and later allied with New Phyrexia for a darksteel body.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who ordered the theft of the bridge and planned to invade Ravnica with it.

entities.name: The Mending
entities.description: The event that stopped all existing planar portals from working.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Praetors
entities.description: The Phyrexian leaders who can use the bridge but are burned and weakened by it.

entities.name: Quiet Furnace
entities.description: Members who periodically cauterize Tezzeret's body.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Vraska, theorized Bolas's plan.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who theorized Bolas's plan and was assigned to hunt Dovin Baan.

entities.name: Chamber of the Guildpact
entities.description: The Ravnican chamber reduced to rubble when Tezzeret opened the bridge.

entities.name: Dreadhorde
entities.description: Bolas's immortal army that invaded Ravnica.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane invaded in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: The plane where the planeswalkers shut the portal off.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: A planeswalker who traveled to Amonkhet to shut off the portal.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker who traveled to Amonkhet to shut off the portal.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A character who helped shut off the portal and later was carried away from the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: A character who traveled to Amonkhet to shut off the portal.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: The dragon revived when the guildmasters removed the portal's scar.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: A planeswalker assigned to hunt Tezzeret whose lightning is redirected.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A character who tracks Tezzeret by the bridge's energy trail.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker assigned to hunt Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Seekers' Sanctum
entities.description: Tezzeret's fortress in Esper on Alara.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A praetor transported to Kaldheim to obtain Tyrite.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane where Vorinclex obtained Tyrite.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor who granted Tezzeret a darksteel body.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane that Tezzeret allied with.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A praetor transported to and from Kamigawa.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane Jin-Gitaxias was sent to.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A planeswalker kidnapped with the bridge who became the first compleated planeswalker.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A praetor transported to New Capenna and left badly wounded.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: The plane Urabrask was sent to.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Tezzeret takes to meet Urabrask.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A praetor sent to Dominaria and back through the bridge.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane Sheoldred's forces were sent to.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker carried away from the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Mana Rig
entities.description: The exploding machine on Dominaria.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The intended primary military transport of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Rona
entities.description: The character Tezzeret last transported to New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Tezzeret steals the Planar Portal by Bolas's order and builds it into his body.
events.quote: Tezzeret took it off the plane, and incorporated it in his body.

events.summary: Jace and Vraska theorize that Bolas plans to use the bridge to invade Ravnica with an army of immortals while trapping its planeswalkers.
events.quote: Jace and Vraska theorized that something on the plane of Ravnica was of extreme interest to Bolas

events.summary: Tezzeret opens the Planar Bridge in the Chamber of the Guildpact, reducing it to rubble, and the Dreadhorde invades Ravnica.
events.quote: Tezzeret opened up the Planar Bridge in the Chamber of the Guildpact on Ravnica, reducing it to rubble

events.summary: Dack Fayden, Ob Nixilis, Karn and Samut travel to Amonkhet and shut off the portal.
events.quote: traveled to Amonkhet and shut it off

events.summary: The portal in Tezzeret's chest explodes, making the larger portal implode; Tezzeret planeswalks away defeated.
events.quote: The portal inside Tezerret's chest exploded

events.summary: The guildmasters' combined magic removes the portal's scar, reviving Niv-Mizzet.
Ral Zarek, Kaya and Vraska are assigned to hunt Tezzeret, Liliana Vess and Dovin Baan.
events.quote: were assigned to hunt down and kill Tezzeret

events.summary: Tezzeret retreats to the Seekers' Sanctum, where the Wanderer tracks him; he uses the bridge to redirect Ral's lightning.
events.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to redirect Ral's lightning strikes

events.summary: After his victory Tezzeret uses the bridge to orchestrate the abandonment of his fortress, probably intending to be followed.
events.quote: he used the Planar Bridge to orchestrate the abandonment of his fortress

events.summary: The bridge sends Vorinclex to Kaldheim to obtain Tyrite and brings him back to New Phyrexia, burning off his organic parts each way.
events.quote: The Planar Bridge was used to transport the praetor Vorinclex to the plane of Kaldheim to obtain a sample of Tyrite

events.summary: Tezzeret transports Jin-Gitaxias to and from Kamigawa and kidnaps Tamiyo.
events.quote: He also used it to kidnap Tamiyo

events.summary: Tezzeret transports Urabrask to New Capenna, leaving him badly wounded.
events.quote: Tezzeret used the Planar Bridge to transport Urabrask to New Capenna

events.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien Reid the bridge was corrupted from ferrying Phyrexian forces and praetors across the multiverse.
events.quote: Tezzeret revealed the Bridge got corrupted from ferrying Phyrexian forces and the other praetors across the multiverse

events.summary: The bridge sends Sheoldred and Phyrexian forces to Dominaria.
events.quote: The Planar Bridge was used to transport Sheoldred and some Phyrexian forces to the plane of Dominaria

events.summary: The bridge carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from the exploding Mana Rig back to New Phyrexia.
events.quote: away from the exploding Mana Rig back to New Phyrexia

events.summary: Burnt out, Tezzeret is granted a darksteel body by Elesh Norn and the Planar Bridge is removed; its fate is unknown.
events.quote: Elesh Norn granted him the darksteel body

relations.quote: created by the inventor Rashmi on Avishkar

relations.note: allied with the Phyrexians for a darksteel body
relations.quote: he allied with the Phyrexians to get a new body made of Darksteel
